welcome.text: Welcome to MAXX-ON. Ask about amplifiers or microphones and I will pull a model from the catalogue.

default.text: I can show you amplifiers or microphones.

replies.text: DJX 4000 is a 4000W rack amplifier: 1400W + 1400W RMS @4Ω, bridged 2400W @8Ω. DJX 5000 steps up to 5000W for larger rooms.
MX 168 is a UHF wireless handheld: 40Hz–16kHz, 80–150m range, S/N >100dB. See Wireless in the microphone catalogue.
MAXX-ON amplifiers cover install mixers through high-power racks — DJX, MSSA, MSSB, MTZA, and MX series.
MAXX-ON microphones include wireless handhelds, wired dynamics, and head/tie sets for worship, stage, and install.
